name: SJI International School
summary: Lasallian international school offering IB with a values-led culture.
body: SJI International combines IB academics with Lasallian ethos. It attracts families who want international curriculum with a faith-informed community culture. Admissions are competitive; understand elementary vs high school campus logistics. Formal uniform expectations on photo day are easy to miss in a dual-career morning rush — lay out pieces the night before. Mother-tongue / language info nights are school-specific ops — dual-career households should calendar the portal slot before stacking an art-studio wait the same evening.
waitlistNotes: Faith-community fit conversations may be part of process.
